sources: RIDB campsite catalog for facility 232508 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: $30 a night for tent, camper and motor home sites (group tent sites $60), paid when reserving. An Acadia entrance pass is required while staying in the campground: $35 per private vehicle, valid seven days. Non-US residents 16 and older also pay a $100 nonresident fee unless admitted with an Annual or America the Beautiful pass.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232508/rates (Peak 2026-05-01 to 2026-10-18: RV NONELECTRIC $30) + https://www.nps.gov/acad/planyourvisit/blackwoods-campground.htm ('Tent, camper, and motor home sites: $30') + https://www.nps.gov/acad/planyourvisit/fees.htm (Private Vehicle $35, 'Valid for seven days') + recreation.gov notice (entrance pass required while staying in the campground; $100 non-US-resident fee)

values.note: No showers in the campground (portable showers prohibited); fee showers about half a mile away in Otter Creek. Cell coverage is poor.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232508 ('Flush toilets, running water, and a dump station are provided'; 'There are no showers in the campground') + https://www.nps.gov/acad/planyourvisit/blackwoods-campground.htm (FAQ: 'There are no showers at the Blackwoods Campground')

values.note: NPS gives the 2025 season, May 2 through October 20 (last reservation October 19); off-season and winter camping are not allowed and the gates stay closed until spring. 2026 dates were not posted on the page (last updated November 2024).

season.source: https://www.nps.gov/acad/planyourvisit/blackwoods-campground.htm ('Season Dates: May 2 through Oct 20, 2025'; 'Off-season and winter camping are not allowed at Blackwoods Campground'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: All sites by advance reservation on recreation.gov; none in person at the campground. 90% of sites are released six months ahead on the first of each month at 10 am Eastern, the other 10% at 10 am 14 days before arrival on a rolling basis; same-day reservations if sites are open. Combined limit of 14 nights in Acadia campgrounds between Memorial Day weekend and Columbus Day, 30 nights per calendar year.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232508 (overview; notice on the 14-night and 30-night limits) + https://www.nps.gov/acad/planyourvisit/blackwoods-campground.htm ('Reservations cannot be made through the campground office or in-person')

values.note: 277 bookable sites in the recreation.gov catalog, but only 60 are RV sites (the rest tent-only), plus group tent sites. RV sites list 15 to 35 ft (37 of them 35 ft); 32 are pull-throughs. One vehicle per site; no generators in loop B.

sites.source: RIDB campsite catalog for facility 232508 (60 RV NONELECTRIC, 217 TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC; Max Vehicle Length; Driveway Entry) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232508 ('The majority of Blackwoods' sites are for small and large tents')

summary: Confirmed $30 a night, no electric. Added the $35 seven-day Acadia entrance pass, flush toilets/water/dump and no showers, season (2025 dates May 2-Oct 20; no winter camping), reservation-only with 6-month and 14-day releases, 14-night summer limit, 277 sites of which 60 RV (max 35 ft, 32 pull-throughs). Senior/Access discount not mentioned on these pages, left inherited. Water/sewer at sites not stated.
